description: This file defines the ErrorGrain class, a Orleans grain implementation used for testing error handling, asynchronous operations, and lifecycle behaviors within the Orleans framework. It includes methods that intentionally throw exceptions, perform delays, and handle unobserved task errors for testing robustness.

classes.name: ErrorGrain
classes.description: A specialized Orleans grain implementing error generation, delay, and unobserved task error testing functionalities for unit testing purposes.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Activates the grain asynchronously, logging activation.

methods.name: SetAError
methods.description: Sets an integer value and throws an exception to simulate an error.

methods.name: SetBError
methods.description: Immediately throws an exception to simulate an error.

methods.name: GetAxBError
methods.description: Throws an exception, simulating an error when getting computation result.

methods.name: GetAxBError
methods.description: Overloaded method that throws an exception, simulating an error with input parameters.

methods.name: LongMethod
methods.description: Sleeps for a specified time synchronously.

methods.name: DelayMethod
methods.description: Logs a counter, delays for specified milliseconds asynchronously.

methods.name: UnobservedErrorImmediate
methods.description: Returns a task that throws an unobserved error immediately.

methods.name: UnobservedErrorDelayed
methods.description: Returns a task that throws an unobserved error after a delay.

methods.name: UnobservedErrorContinuation2
methods.description: Returns a task that continues with an error during continuation.

methods.name: UnobservedErrorContinuation3
methods.description: Returns a task that throws an unobserved error during continuation, using Task continuations.

methods.name: UnobservedIgnoredError
methods.description: Starts an error task but ignores it to test unobserved error handling.

methods.name: AddChildren
methods.description: Adds child grains, no specific logic shown.

methods.name: ExecuteDelayed
methods.description: Executes a delay asynchronously, checking if the runtime context remains the same.
